scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server --filter @workspace/gustafta-pkb --filter @workspace/gustafta-mobile -r run build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run test && pnpm --filter @workspace/gustafta-pkb run test && pnpm --filter @workspace/gustafta-mobile run test --runInBand
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.verify:release: pnpm run test && pnpm run build
